items.finding: Official CentraleSupélec history explicitly identifies École Centrale Paris as one of the two institutions merged into CentraleSupélec on 1 January 2015. Imported 2005 and 2012 degree-provider labels refer to the historical predecessor, not a concurrent current institution.
items.recommendation: Preserve exact historical Ecole Centrale Paris name with the imported reports and record a dated predecessor relationship to CentraleSupélec. Do not create a duplicate current doctoral provider or rewrite the historical awarding label to CentraleSupélec. Current CentraleSupélec qualifying doctoral titles require their own verification.

items.finding: Fully opened official Department of Production Engineering page expressly calls its parent Escola Politécnica da Universidade de São Paulo (EP-USP). This is the University of São Paulo's school, not a second doctorate-awarding university. Existing public parent ID university-of-sao-paulo and review remain the appropriate organization identity.
items.recommendation: Link imported Escola Politécnica da USP source label to existing university-of-sao-paulo as school-level identity, preserving historical 2010 reports. Do not create an additional provider or infer the two imported persons' degree subject. The school Production Engineering doctorate is already recorded under USP and is not automatically an English Industrial Engineering title.
